newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Capital call helps Sonae Industria.
newsitem.headline: Capital call helps Sonae Industria.

text.p: A forthcoming capital call at 1,700 escudos per share and bright prospects for the results of Sonae Industria explain the recent rise in price and liquidity of stocks of the Portuguese wood products group, dealers said.
"Good prospects for the fundamentals of the company this year and the capital call are supporting Sonae Industria's share price," a dealer said.

Some analysts said the 1,700 escudos per share price set in the capital call, to take place between June 20 and July 4, was a fair estimate of the company's value, taking into account forecasts for its profits in 1997.

Analysts said they expected Sonae Industrias to post a consolidated net profit of around 1.3 billion escudos in 1997, sharply higher than the 1996 consolidated net profit after minority interests of 0.45 billion escudos.
Sonae Industria has recently opened new factories and has benefited from improved demand and prices, the analysts said.
Sonae Industria's first quarter results are expected to be released at the end of this week or early next week.
Sonae Industria stood at 1,650 escudos, up 40, in volume of 208,977 shares on Lisbon bourse at 1055 GMT.
